main_text.l: Nunc sponse salue: ista, quod sponsalia
Nunc ex Amando Amatus esto congius.
Nunc sponsa, Amando Amata sis mox coniugi.
Septenos decies transfegi, mi Deus, annos,
Et recti ad normam tam longa tempera vita,
Quem si forte ineas, sah, quanto optatius esset
Non esse natum, aut mox mori?
Finitum tamen est deliqui, Maxime, quidquid,
Horrenda sed enim paena guttaque cruoris,
Seruandis natus miseris, et crimina fassis,
Spes igitur miserum fuet hac me sola futurum

page.notes: Lines of the Greek-marked verse and the abbreviated "&" forms are transcribed as close as legible; the line "Saluete ille, ista, ..." is partly illegible in the scan. Some words in the first poem are doubtful.
